user.title: Add a moonLedRemote moon lamp
user.description: Pick the infrared emitter entity this lamp's IR receiver is in range of (an ir_rf_proxy transmitter on the IR Mate node -- see the repo's README for the ESPHome-side setup this depends on).

data_description.address: 16-bit NEC address, decimal (61184 = 0xEF00, the confirmed value for this lamp).
data_description.carrier_frequency: IR carrier frequency in Hz. 38000 for this lamp.
data_description.repeat_count: How many short repeat bursts follow the frame. This lamp needs at least 3 to commit a command -- see HANDOFF-moonled-ir-mate.md.

abort.no_infrared_emitters: No infrared emitter entities found. Set up an ir_rf_proxy (or other infrared) emitter first.
abort.already_configured: This infrared emitter is already configured as a moon lamp.
